message: The other day, I was trying to teach my kids about fire safety. I thought I was being all clever, explaining how we should have an escape plan. But they just wanted to know if we could turn it into a game. So, we ended up pretending to be firefighters, racing to our "safe zone" while I tried to squeeze in tips about smoke alarms. It turned out to be a fun way to talk about safety without the heavy stuff. Sometimes, I think it’s more about how we share these lessons than the lessons themselves. What’s your go-to way to talk safety with your little ones?
